kitchen-cabinet-price-malaysia.seo_description_en: Kitchen cabinet cost in the Klang Valley: melamine RM280–450 per linear foot, acrylic RM600–900, solid wood RM800–1,500, base units with installation.
kitchen-cabinet-price-malaysia.seo_description_zh: 巴生谷厨房地柜价格：三聚氰胺 RM280–450/延尺，高光亚克力 RM600–900，实木 RM800–1,500，含供货与安装。
kitchen-cabinet-price-malaysia.seo_description_ms: Kos kabinet dapur di Lembah Klang: melamin RM280–450 sekaki linear, akrilik RM600–900, kayu padu RM800–1,500, unit bawah termasuk pemasangan.

built-in-cabinet-cost-malaysia.seo_description_en: Built-in cabinet cost in Malaysia: a TV console runs RM280–600 per linear foot, a 1.2 m melamine shoe cabinet RM1,800–2,800 per unit, before extras.
built-in-cabinet-cost-malaysia.seo_description_zh: 马来西亚定制柜价格：电视柜 RM280–600/延尺，1.2 米三聚氰胺鞋柜 RM1,800–2,800 每座，不含额外项目。
built-in-cabinet-cost-malaysia.seo_description_ms: Kos kabinet terbina di Malaysia: konsol TV RM280–600 sekaki linear, kabinet kasut melamin 1.2 m RM1,800–2,800 seunit, di luar item tambahan.

custom-wardrobe-price-malaysia.seo_description_en: Wardrobe cost in the Klang Valley: an 8 ft hinged-door wardrobe runs RM500 per linear foot, sliding doors RM770, soft-close drawers RM150 each.
custom-wardrobe-price-malaysia.seo_description_zh: 巴生谷衣柜价格：8 英尺开门衣柜 RM500/延尺，防跳推门 RM770，缓冲抽屉 RM150 每个。
custom-wardrobe-price-malaysia.seo_description_ms: Kos almari di Lembah Klang: almari pintu berengsel 8 kaki RM500 sekaki linear, pintu gelangsar RM770, laci soft-close RM150 seunit.
